attribute.name: TTL_week
attribute.description: Time To Live (in weeks) After this time, archives can be safely deleted

attribute.name: MinArchiveSize_MB
attribute.description: Minimum size for archives (in Megabytes) As soon as the total size of the cached file exceeds this threshold, a ZIP archive is created

attribute.name: MaxArchiveSize_MB
attribute.description: Maximum size for archives (in Megabytes) No archive will be done bigger than this

attribute.name: MaxDelay_s
attribute.description: Maximum delay (in seconds) As soon as a registered file becomes that old, a ZIP archive is created

attribute.name: BundlePolicy
attribute.description: File bundling policy for dataset, possible values: * Default: use DefaultBundlePolicy from CoCaServer config, * SingleFile: archive files individually in subdirectories year/dataset/file-name.ext * ZipBundle: large files without slashes in names are archived individually with names coca_dataset_file-name.ext, smaller files are packed into ZIP archives with name coca_dataset_NNNN.zip * ZipBundleDir: small files are packed into ZIP archives with names year/dataset/coca_dataset_NNNN.zip, large files are archived individually with names year/dataset/file-name.ext

attribute.name: Quota_MB
attribute.description: Quota (in Megabytes) allotted for this dataset on the server. When maximum quota is reached, some space will have to be freed on the local cache before accepting new files. Zero (or null) means no maximum is set: files are not deleted until there is space available in the filesystem.

attribute.name: Database
attribute.description: Connection string, in CORAL syntax: see section 5.3.2.2 in http://pool.cern.ch/coral/currentReleaseDoc/UserGuide.html#Public_API

attribute.name: CacheDir
attribute.description: Top directory for local cache

attribute.name: CDRDir
attribute.description: Directory read by the CDR script (path on machine running the CoCa server)

attribute.name: CDRHost
attribute.description: Fully qualified hostname of the machine on which the directory CDRDir physically resides

attribute.name: CDRDir_on_CDRHost
attribute.description: Directory read by the CDR script (path on CDRHost)

attribute.name: DefaultTTL_week
attribute.description: Default TTL Each dataset can define its own Time To Live (in weeks) After this time, archives can be safely deleted

attribute.name: DefaultMinArchiveSize_MB
attribute.description: Default MinArchiveSize Each dataset can define its own Minimum size for archives (in Megabytes) As soon as the total size of the cached file exceeds this threshold, a ZIP archive is created

attribute.name: DefaultMaxArchiveSize_MB
attribute.description: Default MaxArchiveSize Each dataset can define its own Maximum size for archives (in Megabytes) No archive will be done bigger than this

attribute.name: DefaultMaxDelay_s
attribute.description: Default MaxDelay Each dataset can define its own Maximum delay (in seconds) As soon as a registered file becomes that old, a ZIP archive is created

attribute.name: DefaultBundlePolicy
attribute.description: Global BundlePolicy. Datasets can override global value with their BundlePolicy attribute. For the meaning of the specific enum values check Dataset.BundlePolicy description. By default no bundling is done and files are archived individually.

attribute.name: CASTOR_dir
attribute.description: CASTOR directory where archives will be copied.

attribute.name: FreePercentGoal
attribute.description: Free space to keep on cache disk, in percent of total disk space.

attribute.name: MaxCopyRetries
attribute.description: Max. number of retries when copying files from clients.

relationship.name: Datasets
relationship.description: If any dataset is specified, only those datasets will be accepted. Othjerwise, all the datasets will be accepted.

attribute.name: ProcessUmask
attribute.description: Process umask

attribute.name: NewDirGroup
attribute.description: Group for new directories

attribute.name: NewDirHasSetGid
attribute.description: Whether a new directory shall have the setgid bit enabled
